jobs.description: We are the UK's leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men's & Women's Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper's Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don't just create content – we shape culture. Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that's brought us here. We believe in each other's potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people's lives. We're proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history. Hearst UK operates an in-office policy with flexible Fridays. Our office is based at House of Hearst, 30 Panton Street, St James's, London, SW1Y 4AJ , where teams collaborate in person and connect across brands and functions. Salary - Circa £55,000 - Salary is dependent on experience and will be assessed in line with the candidate's skills, knowledge and relevant expertise. The Role… As our QA Engineer, you’ll play a key role in making sure Hearst’s websites and apps deliver a seamless, reliable experience for millions of users across the UK. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering and Editorial teams, you’ll test new features, challenge how things work, uncover issues and help bring great digital experiences to life. You’ll work across our global platforms, making sure new developments are not only technically robust, but work brilliantly for our UK audiences. From new product launches to everyday improvements, you’ll help set the standard for quality at every stage of the journey. Main Duties… Plan and carry out testing for website and app features across different devices, browsers and operating systems. Check that changes meet agreed requirements and work well for people using our products. Report bugs clearly, including steps to reproduce them, and work with engineers to confirm fixes. Run regression tests to check that new releases have not affected existing features. Contribute to test plans and release checks throughout the development process. Work with engineering teams on optimising automated testing by identifying suitable test cases. Use AI enabled testing tools and workflows to help identify risks, improve test coverage and make quality checks more efficient. Raise usability, accessibility and performance concerns with the relevant teams. What We Are Looking For… Experience testing websites and mobile apps, with a clear understanding of functional and regression testing. Confidence using different devices, browsers and operating systems to identify and investigate issues. The ability to write clear bug reports and communicate findings to technical and non-technical colleagues. A methodical approach, good attention to detail and the judgement to prioritise issues by their impact on users. Familiarity with test management or bug tracking tools, such as Jira. Some experience with test automation tools or basic scripting; this is desirable. A collaborative mindset and interest in improving the quality and accessibility of digital products. Snag luxe beauty steals at our legendary office sample sales - score big on top brands without breaking the bank! Inclusion, Health & Wellbeing: Feel Your Best Stay healthy with Specsavers eye care, a company-funded Health Cash Plan, and access to mental health support. Get active and stress-free with discounted gym memberships and the Cycle to Work scheme. Embrace flexibility with a Location Flex and Holiday Exchange to take time when you need it. Take time to give back with a Charity Day and access wellbeing resources whenever you need them. Join one of our Hearst ERG Groups. jobs.title: Accounting Automation Engineer
jobs.description: About us Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ About the role We are hiring an Accounting Automation Engineer to replace manual accounting work across a multi-entity, multi-country enterprise, using Claude Code and agentic AI. You will use Claude Code and agentic AI, plus Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, to automate accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end close and the wider day-to-day accounting operation. You need strong IFRS or US GAAP knowledge to get the numbers right, because an automation that posts wrong entries is worse than no automation. We build agentic AI systems and AI agents, not fixed step-by-step workflows. Experience with rule-based workflow builders such as n8n or Zapier is not relevant to this role. Titles we will consider: Accounting Automation Engineer, Finance Engineer, Financial Systems Engineer, Technical Accountant (with engineering background), Accounting Systems Manager (with engineering background). Key Responsibilities The goal is to automate the repeatable core of enterprise accounting, with human review kept only where judgment is needed. Accounts payable Invoice capture and data extraction from PDFs and email, using AI where useful Vendor matching, coding suggestions, and 2-way/3-way PO matching Duplicate invoice detection and approval routing Payment run preparation and vendor statement reconciliation Accounts receivable Invoice generation and delivery Cash application and bank receipt matching Aging reports, dunning and collections reminders Credit note handling and bad debt/ECL provision support Reconciliations Bank and card reconciliations across all accounts and currencies Balance sheet account reconciliations (prepayments, accruals, deferred revenue, fixed assets) Intercompany and subledger-to-GL reconciliations Exception reports that flag only the items a human needs to review Month-end close Close checklist tracking and scheduled reminders Recurring, accrual, prepayment and amortization journals Depreciation runs and FX revaluation Trial balance checks, flux/variance analysis, and draft commentary Management reporting packs General accounting operations Expense report and employee reimbursement checks Chart of accounts and master data hygiene Audit support: evidence collection, PBC lists, sample extraction Data pipelines between ERP, banks, payment platforms and spreadsheets Qualifications Two things matter most, and we weigh them above everything else: Strong knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP Real experience with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, backed by solid engineering basics We accept two paths: an accountant who learned to code, or an engineer who learned accounting. Both are judged on the same practical test. Hands-on experience building automations with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript (either is fine) Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, with solid engineering basics, shipping working scripts and agents Ability to run local scripts and schedule jobs (cron, task schedulers or CI pipelines) Strong knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP, shown by ACCA, ACA, CPA or equivalent, or by several years of hands-on accounting experience Experience with core processes: AP, AR, bank reconciliation, month-end close Comfort working with APIs and MCP servers, CSV/Excel data and basic SQL Care for accuracy, controls and audit trails Nice to have Experience in multi-entity or multi-currency environments, including intercompany and consolidation Experience reconciling payment processor statements across multiple jurisdictions and currencies Experience with shared cost services that invoice group companies, including complex expense splits and automated invoice generation Experience with an ERP and its API (which ERP does not matter) Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool use and MCP servers Knowledge of VAT/GST and e-invoicing rules in several jurisdictions Experience with Git, testing and basic cloud deployment Prior experience in a finance transformation or accounting operations team Additional languages, where our entities operate in non-English markets Location Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours. Benefits Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! jobs.description: Du bist für die SPS-Entwicklung, HMI-Integration und Inbetriebnahme von industriellen Automatisierungs- und Robotiksystemen zuständig. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass die Steuerungslogik, die Schnittstellen und das Systemverhalten in realen Kundenumgebungen zuverlässig funktionieren. Um unsere Projekte reibungslos umzusetzen, arbeiten wir als Team eng mit unseren Kunden und der BÄR Automation GmbH in der Nähe von Heilbronn zusammen. Dafür bist du bereit, im Umfang von ca. 60 % gelegentlich im Inland und Ausland zu reisen. Your Responsibilities SPS-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst und erweiterst SPS-Programme für industrielle Automatisierungssysteme und robotiknahe Anwendungen. HMI-Integration: Du implementierst und pflegst HMI- und steuerungsnahe Schnittstellen für Betrieb, Diagnose und Prozessführung. Inbetriebnahme: Du begleitest Inbetriebnahmen vor Ort und stellst die funktionale Übergabe in die Kundenumgebung sicher. Fehlerdiagnose: Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in Steuerungslogik, Feldkommunikation und Systemverhalten. Integration: Du arbeitest eng mit Mechanik, Elektrik, Projektengineering und Deployment zusammen, um Gesamtsysteme stabil in Betrieb zu bringen. Dokumentation: Du erstellst und pflegst technische Dokumentation zu Steuerungslogik, Parametrierung und Inbetriebnahmestatus. Essential Skills Technischer Hintergrund: Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich. SPS-Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Anpassung von SPS-Programmen in industriellen Automatisierungsumgebungen. Inbetriebnahme: Fundierte Praxiserfahrung in Inbetriebnahme, Fehlerdiagnose und Optimierung von Automatisierungssystemen im Feld. Steuerungstechnik: Arbeitendes Verständnis von HMI-, Feldbus- und steuerungsnahen Integrationsaufgaben. Industriepraxis: Erfahrung mit realen Produktions- oder Anlagenumgebungen und deren technischen Randbedingungen. Arbeitsweise: Selbständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Vorgehensweise mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Orientierung. Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse für die technische Abstimmung. Beneficial Skills Robotikbezug: Erfahrung mit robotikbasierten Automatisierungssystemen und deren Integration in Steuerungsumgebungen. Safety-Nähe: Berührungspunkte mit Sicherheitslogik, Sicherheitskonzepten oder CE-nahen Themen. Netzwerke: Erfahrung mit industriellen Kommunikationsschnittstellen und Feldbus- bzw. Netzwerkthemen. Feldpraxis: Vertrautheit mit Kundenprojekten, Reiseanteilen und direkter Vor-Ort-Arbeit. What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
